[[File:Callandri.png|right|thumb|Callandri wore her hair in aconlins]]
'''Aconlins''' were a braided [[Hair/Legends|hairstyle]] that was popular in [[Tilam City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pendal]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Callandri]] braided her long hair into aconlins.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
